food_name: Atlantic salmon muscle, 12°C feeding trial (FM-FO diet)
food_database_record_id: Treatment FM-FO; mean of tank values
food_part: Muscle, Norwegian quality cut (2 cm above lateral line)
synonym_verification_status: Source analyte astaxanthin; all-E standard used; Stage B PubChem CID/InChIKey checked
mapping_review_rationale: Source explicitly quantifies astaxanthin in Atlantic salmon muscle by HPLC using known-concentration crystalline all-E-astaxanthin standard. Exact Stage B CID/full InChIKey checked; no Stage B edits.
moisture_basis: muscle tissue; source does not specify fresh- or dry-weight denominator; no conversion made
analytical_method: HPLC carotenoid determination in muscle using Spherisorb S5-CN nitrile column with 20% acetone in n-hexane; known-concentration crystalline all-E-astaxanthin standard, spectrophotometrically standardized at 470 nm; geometrical isomer correction described
extraction_method: Homogenized fillet samples from individual fish were thawed; carotenoid extraction/analysis followed the cited tissue procedure (Bjerkeng et al. 1997)
sample_size: 3 tank replicates; six fish per tank sampled for carotenoid analyses; source table reports mean per tank ± SEM
source_title: Dietary Content of Plant Ingredients and Phospholipids Affects Astaxanthin Utilization and Lipid Deposition in Atlantic Salmon (Salmo salar L.)
database_reference: Table 4, Muscle / Astaxanthin, 12°C treatment FM-FO: 2.29 ± 0.39 mg/kg; SEM per tank; methods Section 2.3.2
extraction_notes: 12°C controlled-feeding treatment FM-FO; six fish sampled per tank and values reported as mean per tank ± SEM (N=3 tanks). Source explicitly reports mg/kg muscle but does not specify fresh/dry denominator; retained source value as-is. This is an experimental feeding-study result, not a population or market average.
uncertainty_notes: Source table gives 2.29 ± 0.39 mg/kg. Diet-dependent experimental value; moisture basis not reported. No exposure estimate or fresh-weight assumption made.
